# Self-hosted Three.js

Three.js 0.180.0: module/core builds, GLTFLoader and BufferGeometryUtils. MIT notice retained in three/LICENSE.
Downloaded from fixed https://unpkg.com/three@0.180.0/ URLs on October 3, 2026. index.html maps the official loader’s bare three import to the local build. Keep the four files and their relative paths together when updating.
No package manifest or lockfile changes. The character module and model are served locally. The lottie vendor files are retained from the earlier prototype but are not used by the restored implementation.
